.I rewatched the Niner's win over the #Seahawks by a score of 32-29 yesterday and what impressed me most was how the Niners defensive line & backfield were so stout getting 5 sacks and getting 3 takeaways that let to Niners TDs.But the loss of Deebo (yet another injury) & the fact that Evans (who is also hurt but still playing) is the Niners' only remaining option at WR are concerning.The defense also stopped the Seahawks by making them go 4 & out with less than a minute left to go in the game, which was helped by a rare Darnold & SJN incomplete pass on 3rd down that the defense had nothing to do with.
